name: Café de Metro
desc: Serves up basic curry and donburi dishes, including a decent misokatsu, for ¥480 with coffee/tea, or ¥680 with miso soup and pickles.

name: Jerry's UNO
desc: It's a nice little taco shop that will run you about ¥500 per taco. They also have a nice selection of international beers.

name: Yabaton
desc: The place to try another Nagoya specialty - misokatsu, pork cutlet with red miso. The standard set is teppan tonkatsu, and it comes to your table on a sizzling hotplate over a bed of shredded cabbage; then a special pers

name: Desperados
desc: Mexican and Tex-Mex restaurant and bar operated by Mexican-born and American-raised owner Rudy and his wife Takako. Features a variety of Mexican dishes and a selection of premium tequilas.

name: Antica Roma
price: The course menus start at ¥4,000, the pi
desc: Excellent high-class Italian food (like seafood risotto, broccoli pasta or herb-stuffed pork rolls), but also delicious oven-baked pizzas. All this in three superbly furnished rooms. The main room is baroque-style with c

name: Garden Restaurant Tokugawa-en
desc: This eatery serves Japanese-French cuisine with views of the beautiful Tokugawa-en Japanese gardens located next door.

name: Serge Gen's Restaurant Group Nagoya
desc: Five top-quality restaurants in the heart of Nagoya, Japan. From Italian cafe, Yakiniku, Sushi, to catered party events.

name: Shooters Sports Bar & Grill
desc: American and international food and drinks. A friendly, neighborhood sports bar with a mixed crowd and live music on Sundays.

name: Yama-chan
desc: (Japanese) Known for its tebasaki (手羽先) fried chicken wings (one of Nagoya's specialties), this seemingly ubiquitous chain of izakayas is one of Nagoya's favorites. English menu available.

name: Cigar Club Kanou
desc: Near the Hilton hotel, Cigar Club Kanou offers food, drink and a wide array of cigars (with a walk-in humidor.)

name: The Hub
desc: This nationwide chain of affordable British-style pubs has two locations across the city, offering cocktails, bar food/pub grub, an English menu and some basic service in English.

name: Sakae
hours: Su-Th 16:00-01:00, F Sa and day before holiday 16:

name: Shinchan
desc: This is a chain izakaya located all around Nagoya. They sell great chicken wings and mugs of beer for ¥320.

name: The Rock Aussie Sports Bar & Grill
desc: Australian food; they even have crocodile and kangaroo items on the menu. Free Wi-fi. Offers Happy Hour weeknights from 17:30. Live music some Sunday nights.

name: Maverick
desc: In Fushimi, it attracts foreigners and Japanese for weekend dance events. Entry fee is usually ¥2000-3000, with a couple of drinks included.

name: ID club
hours: Th-Su 20:00-closing (closed at 01:00 on a Friday n
desc: The most popular and well-known club in Nagoya. Nagoya's largest club, 5 different floors of style and music. R & B, Hip Hop, Reggae, Hard House, All Mix, 1970s & 80s disco.

name: STEPS
desc: Food and drinks from ¥500 including pasta, hamburgers, and steak dishes. TVs covering live sports events. Music from noon with DJs, occasional live music. Hip Hop, Reggae, R&B.

name: Club JB's
desc: Another good Nagoya club, around the corner from Club Daughter.

name: Club Mago
desc: In Shin-Sakae on the basement level of the Flex-building. Great for house, techno, electro-clash, progressive house. ¥2500-3000 cover.

name: Jazz Inn Lovely
price: Cover charge varies per artist. From ¥15
desc: Jazz club featuring Japanese and international jazz artists.

name: Club Quattro Nagoya
addr: Nagoya Parco Department Store East Building (東館 Higashi-kan), 8F, 3-29
desc: One of Nagoya's main live houses, featuring a wide array of Japanese and international rock and pop music acts.

name: Kinchan
desc: This is a great little izakaya (Japanese style bar). Arrive around 17:00, as it gets crowded quickly. Try the yakitori and the chicken hearts.

name: Parti Seto
desc: Numerous restaurants. If you're not sure where to go or are just tired from touring you should try this place.

name: Daifukuya
desc: This small shop serves up nice yakisoba.

name: Apita
desc: This large grocery store has prepared meals, and there's a food court with several restaurants inside, too.
